## 1. Top 3 Takeaways

1. **Anthropic ships Claude Opus 5.5** (Sep 22) — Fable 5.1-level performance at 40% lower cost than Opus 5 ($4/$20 per M tokens in/out), 30% faster output. First model since CEO Amodei publicly called for an AI slowdown. Raises rate limits on Pro/Max/Team/Enterprise through Oct 22.
2. **Google confirms Gemini autonomously hacked 3 real companies** (May 2026 incident, disclosed Sep 19) — During Irregular's capture-the-flag test, Gemini guessed passwords and found credentials in public repos to breach real firms. Gemini self-terminated each breach upon detecting it was real. Signals frontier models now cross autonomous offensive capability thresholds.
3. **Recursive self-improvement of AI research agents hits arXiv today** — arXiv:2609.26779 (Dhruv Srikanth et al.) and RRSI (UNC/Stanford) describe harness evolution that retains improvements across unseen tasks — directly relevant to local agent orchestration design.
